<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916846_theRebbe_939" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916846_theRebbe_939__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Based on the earlier point about the two aspects of the main Shechinah in the lower realms, the advantage of the Divine revelation drawn down through human service after the sin is superior in both aspects compared to before the sin.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And according to the above</t>
    <t s="1">(section 2)</t>
    <t s="2">that in the matter of the main Shechinah in the lower realms, two aspects are emphasized — the main Shechinah</t>
    <t s="3">(which is above worlds),</t>
    <t s="4">and in the lower realms</t>
    <t s="5">(that this aspect of “main” being in the lower realms is</t>
    <t s="6">(also)</t>
    <t s="7">from the perspective of the lower realms themselves)</t>
    <t s="8">— it must be said,</t>
    <t s="9">that the advantage in the drawing down of the main Shechinah into the lower realms after it departed, relative to how it was at the beginning of creation,</t>
    <t s="10">is in both aspects.</t>
    <t s="11">For the G-dly revelation drawn down through the service of man now is a revelation more elevated than the revelation drawn down through the service of Adam before the sin,</t>
    <t s="12">and the drawing down of the revelation into the world</t>
    <t s="13">(into the lower realms)</t>
    <t s="14">now is in a more inward manner.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>To understand this, it is explained that although sin is contrary to the Supernal Will, it is intentional, rooted in the diminution of the moon, the breaking of the vessels of Tohu, and ultimately the first tzimtzum which is a withdrawal opposite to the Will, providing a place for sin.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood by first explaining what was brought above, that although sin</t>
    <t s="2">(the sin of the Tree of Knowledge,</t>
    <t s="3">and likewise all sins)</t>
    <t s="4">is the opposite of the Supernal Will,</t>
    <t s="5">nevertheless it is intentional.</t>
    <t s="6">And the matter is as stated by the Baal HaHilula in the maamarim of the holiday of Geulah42,</t>
    <t s="7">that just as every thing below has a root and source above,</t>
    <t s="8">so too regarding sin and iniquity,</t>
    <t s="9">there is a cause and a place for this above.</t>
    <t s="10">And he brings a proof for this from the first sin that was in the world,</t>
    <t s="11">which is the sin of the Tree of Knowledge.</t>
    <t s="12">For at first glance it is perplexing,</t>
    <t s="13">behold, Adam was at the ultimate level of elevation, both from the perspective of his soul, for his wisdom was greater than the wisdom of the separate intellects43,</t>
    <t s="14">and from the perspective of his body, for the body of Adam was the handiwork of the Holy One, blessed be He44,</t>
    <t s="15">and the heel of Adam eclipsed the orb of the sun45,</t>
    <t s="16">so how is it possible that he sinned and transgressed the command of G-d?</t>
    <t s="17">And to add,</t>
    <t s="18">that according to the statement of our Sages, of blessed memory46,</t>
    <t s="19">that the reason man was created alone is to teach us that every single Jew is comparable to Adam,</t>
    <t s="20">it must be said,</t>
    <t s="21">that the wonder of how the matter of sin is possible applies also to each and every Jew47.</t>
    <t s="22">For since the second soul within him is literally a part of G-d above48,</t>
    <t s="23">and also regarding the body of a Jew it is stated49</t>
    <t s="24">“and we have chosen from every nation and tongue” and it is brought in Tanya50</t>
    <t s="25">that this refers to the physical body which is similar in its materiality to the bodies of the nations of the world,</t>
    <t s="26">and according to the known principle51</t>
    <t s="27">that the true essence of the matter of choice is in the Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="28">it is understood,</t>
    <t s="29">that in the body of a Jew there is an advantage even over the soul,</t>
    <t s="30">for in it</t>
    <t s="31">(in the body)</t>
    <t s="32">specifically is the choice of the Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="33">how is it possible that there be sin in a Jew?</t>
    <t s="34">And the explanation of this</t>
    <t s="35">(in the aforementioned maamar of the Baal HaHilula),</t>
    <t s="36">is that the cause and the place for sin</t>
    <t s="37">(in its simple sense,</t>
    <t s="38">below)</t>
    <t s="39">in the matters above is the diminution of the moon52.</t>
    <t s="40">And higher than that,</t>
    <t s="41">the cause and place for sin is — the breaking of the vessels of Tohu.</t>
    <t s="42">That is, the creation of the world of Tohu,</t>
    <t s="43">a world that did not benefit Him53</t>
    <t s="44">(therefore there was the breaking in it),</t>
    <t s="45">is</t>
    <t s="46">(as it were)</t>
    <t s="47">the opposite of the Will.</t>
    <t s="48">Therefore it is a cause and place for sin.</t>
    <t s="49">And higher than that,</t>
    <t s="50">the cause and place for sin is — the first tzimtzum which was in the manner of withdrawal.</t>
    <t s="51">For the Supernal Will is that there be a revelation of light,</t>
    <t s="52">and the withdrawal of light</t>
    <t s="53">(the first tzimtzum)</t>
    <t s="54">is</t>
    <t s="55">(as it were)</t>
    <t s="56">the opposite of the Will</t>
    <t s="57">[for although the intention of the tzimtzum is for the sake of revelation,</t>
    <t s="58">nevertheless the tzimtzum itself is the opposite of the Will54].</t>
    <t s="59">And the matter of the opposite of the Will</t>
    <t s="60">(so to speak)</t>
    <t s="61">that is in the first tzimtzum is a cause and place</t>
    <t s="62">(through the breaking of the vessels of Tohu and the diminution of the moon)</t>
    <t s="63">for sin,</t>
    <t s="64">which is the opposite of the Will in its simple sense.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The proof that even the opposite of the Will is intentional is primarily from the first tzimtzum, which was not a necessity but a deliberate act to reveal the aspect of concealment stemming from the capacity of the Atzmus, making this world a dwelling for the Atzmus.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it should be noted,</t>
    <t s="1">that the proof that even the matter of the opposite of the Will is intentional,</t>
    <t s="2">is primarily from the first tzimtzum.</t>
    <t s="3">For the diminution of the moon,</t>
    <t s="4">although the Holy One, blessed be He, diminished the moon,</t>
    <t s="5">nevertheless the cause for this was the accusation of the moon55.</t>
    <t s="6">And also the breaking of the vessels of Tohu,</t>
    <t s="7">although the creation of the world of Tohu was initially in a manner of building with the intent to demolish56,</t>
    <t s="8">it can be said,</t>
    <t s="9">that through the existence of the tzimtzum,</t>
    <t s="10">which is the root of the coming into being of the worlds,</t>
    <t s="11">it was determined that the coming into being of the world of Tikkun would be after the building and demolition of Tohu57,</t>
    <t s="12">building with the intent to demolish and demolishing with the intent to build56.</t>
    <t s="13">And the primary proof that even the matter of the opposite of the Will is not by chance, G-d forbid, but rather intentional, is from the first tzimtzum.</t>
    <t s="14">For regarding the tzimtzum, it cannot be said that there was a necessity, so to speak, for the tzimtzum in order for the coming into being of the worlds to be possible,</t>
    <t s="15">for the entire matter of the coming into being of the worlds</t>
    <t s="16">(world [olam] means concealment58)</t>
    <t s="17">is from the tzimtzum.</t>
    <t s="18">For the desire for worlds in the Ein Sof before the tzimtzum is that there be worlds in which there will be a revelation of light.</t>
    <t s="19">For since the matter of light is revelation,</t>
    <t s="20">also the desire for worlds that was in the light is</t>
    <t s="21">(not for the worlds themselves,</t>
    <t s="22">but rather)</t>
    <t s="23">for the revelation that will be in the worlds.</t>
    <t s="24">And from this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="25">that the intention in the tzimtzum</t>
    <t s="26">[the withdrawal of light, in order that worlds whose matter is concealment come into being]</t>
    <t s="27">is not only in order that through this the desire for worlds that was initially in the light before the tzimtzum59 be fulfilled,</t>
    <t s="28">but rather there is in this an additional intention60,</t>
    <t s="29">which is the opposite of the desire that was initially61.</t>
    <t s="30">That is,</t>
    <t s="31">that the intention of the tzimtzum as it is in the light</t>
    <t s="32">(that the Ein Sof contracted Himself)</t>
    <t s="33">is that there be revelation in the worlds that come into being from the tzimtzum,</t>
    <t s="34">and the intention of the tzimtzum as it is in the tzimtzum itself is — that in it is revealed the aspect of concealment that is above revelation,</t>
    <t s="35">and that is that the Atzmus is not compelled, G-d forbid, in the matter of revelation, and it is within His ability to be</t>
    <t s="36">(also)</t>
    <t s="37">in concealment.</t>
    <t s="38">Rather, the revelation of the aspect of concealment</t>
    <t s="39">[that the concealment is because the Atzmus is not compelled, G-d forbid, in the matter of revelation]</t>
    <t s="40">is through the revelation that is drawn down after the tzimtzum.</t>
    <t s="41">For through the revelation drawn down in the worlds that came into being from the tzimtzum,</t>
    <t s="42">they are able to sense</t>
    <t s="43">(in addition to the sensation of revelation)</t>
    <t s="44">also the root and cause of the concealment within them,</t>
    <t s="45">which is from the capacity of the Atzmus.</t>
    <t s="46">[And this can be connected to the matter of a dwelling in the lower realms,</t>
    <t s="47">that this lowly physical world becomes a dwelling for the Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="48">for in this world is the primary concealment,</t>
    <t s="49">and through the revelation that the concealment within it is from the capacity of the Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="50">it becomes a dwelling for the Atzmus].</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
